svg.aria-label: Five nested rings drawn around a bug, each labelled with what to read and the wrong guess it removes. The error message, in full: guessing the cause from line one. The logs, in order: assuming the logs are useless. The ticket, beyond the title: fixing the wrong symptom. The code with its callers and tests: breaking something you never looked at. The PR and commit history: undoing a decision you didn't know was made.
svg.text: each ring takes minutes, and removes a whole class of wrong guesses
removes: guessing the cause from line one
removes: assuming the logs are useless
removes: breaking what you never looked at
removes: undoing a decision you didn't know about
most guesses die in the first two rings. the outer ones stop the fix from causing the next bug.
